filings.ns: Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited disclosed that the Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal, Kolkata, ruled in its favor on 18.11.2026. filings.label: Clarification on price / volume move
filings.subject: : Company’s Response/Clarification to the Proxy Advisory Report issued by Institutional Investor Advisory Services (IIAS)
filings.summary: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Company s Response/Clarification to the Proxy Advisory Report issued by Institutional Investor Advisory Services (IIAS)
filings.ns: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited filed a response to a proxy advisory report from Institutional Investor Advisory Services regarding proposed amendments to its ESOP Plan 2021. The company seeks shareholder approval for these amendments via a Postal Ballot Notice dated October 1, 2026. The response addresses IIAS observations on face value exercise prices, performance frameworks, and individual grant limits. The company clarifies that discounted options are linked to tenure, rating, and performance conditions. It states that the Net Remuneration Committee has limited discretion to adjust vesting by up to 25 percent. The proposed increase in individual grant limits to 15 lakh options is described as an enabling ceiling. The company also proposes extending the plan to employees of unlisted subsidiaries. The resolutions remain subject to shareholder approval.

filings.ns: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary ACME Sigma Urja Private Limited, has commissioned an additional discharge capacity of 17.91 MW and 74.323 MWh for the FDRE Project in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan. This commissioning occurred on November 24, 2026, with a commercial operation date of November 26, 2026. The total installed capacity for this specific phase is 17.91 MW and 80.240 MWh. Consequently, the subsidiary has achieved a cumulative commissioned BESS discharge capacity of 193.63 MW and 808.262 MWh. The total installed capacity for the subsidiary stands at 193.63 MW and 872.658 MWh. This update relates to the 250 MW and 1069 MWh project located at Village Neemri.

filings.label: Results (growth not read)

filings.summary: Press Release for the unaudited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
filings.ns: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited submitted its unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 25, 2026. The press release reports H1 FY27 revenue from operations at Rs. 2,966.7 Mn, an 80.5% increase year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 200.5 Mn, up 86.9% year-on-year, with a margin of 6.8%. Profit after tax rose to Rs. 35.8 Mn from Rs. 0.4 Mn in H1 FY26. The closing order book as of September 30, 2026, was Rs. 16,561.7 Mn. The intimation was uploaded to the company website.

filings.name: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited

filings.summary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
filings.ns: SFC Environmental Technologies Ltd. filed an Analysts and Investors Presentation regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The filing was submitted to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 25, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website. Consolidated revenue for the half year was Rs. 2,966.7 Mn, up 80.5% year over year. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 200.5 Mn, up 86.9%. Profit after tax was Rs. 35.8 Mn, compared to Rs. 0.4 Mn in the prior period. For the second quarter, revenue was Rs. 1,627.3 Mn, up 68.5%. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 101.9 Mn, up 79.0%. Profit after tax was Rs. 21.0 Mn, compared to Rs. 3.2 Mn in the prior period.

filings.name: Wipro Limited
filings.label: MoU / partnership / JV / agreement
filings.summary: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 25, 2026, titled "bp signs strategic partnership with Wipro to build best-in-class finance operations".
filings.ns: Wipro Limited announced a strategic partnership with bp to transform its core finance operations. The collaboration aims to drive efficiency through AI and automation. Approximately 3,000 bp employees supporting finance operations in India, Hungary, and Malaysia will move to Wipro. The new operating model is expected to take effect in 2027, subject to applicable conditions. bp will retain overall accountability for standards, controls, data, and technology governance. PwC will provide controls oversight. This press release was filed with BSE, NSE, and NYSE on November 25, 2026.

filings.summary: LG Electronics India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Proposed sale of equity shares of the Company by LG Electronics Inc., Promoter, to divest a part of its shareholding for complying with Minimum Public Shareholding requirement'.
filings.ns: LG Electronics India Limited intimates that its promoter, LG Electronics Inc., proposes to sell up to 2% of the total issued and paid-up equity share capital, aggregating up to 13,575,447 equity shares, through the open market. The sale aims to comply with minimum public shareholding requirements. The divestment will occur until December 31st, 2026, in single or multiple tranches. As of November 25th, 2026, LG Electronics Inc. holds 85.00% of the company's equity share capital. Upon completion of the proposed sale, its shareholding will reduce to 83.00%. filings.ns: Shukra Medtech Limited proposes raising up to Rs. 648 crore through a preferential allotment of 6 crore equity shares at Rs. 108 per share to promoter Parshva Texchem India Private Limited. The Board meeting scheduled for December 2, 2026, will consider this proposal, along with an increase in authorized share capital and amendments to the Memorandum of Association. The promoter group holds a 51.15% stake as of September 2026. Subject to Board approval, the matter will be placed before shareholders for approval via an Extra-Ordinary General Meeting. For H1 FY27, the company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 67.73 crore, a 501% year-on-year increase, with net profit at Rs. 31.04 crore.

filings.name: Skyways Air Services Limited
filings.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
filings.subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Strategic Expansion of Subsidiary Company, Odyssey Logistics Private Limited, into Defence and Automotive Logistics Segments
filings.summary: Skyways Air Services Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
filings.ns: Skyways Air Services Limited intimates that its material subsidiary, Odyssey Logistics Private Limited, has decided to expand its business into the Defence Logistics and Automotive Logistics segments. This strategic diversification builds upon existing operations in international air and sea freight forwarding and pharmaceutical supply chains. The new verticals will provide end-to-end multimodal supply chain solutions, including specialized cargo handling, time-critical air and ocean freight, customs clearance, warehousing, and domestic distribution. These services are tailored for defence equipment, components, automotive original equipment manufacturers, and ancillaries. The initiative leverages the global network, airline partnerships, and domestic infrastructure of Skyways Air Services Limited. The expansion aims to diversify revenue streams, capture domestic manufacturing growth under Make in India initiatives, and strengthen presence in specialized industrial logistics. The information is placed on record pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

filings.name: Capri Global Capital Limited
filings.label: Other fund raising
filings.subject: Press Release – Capri Global Raises USD 30 Million from the BlueOrchard Microfinance Fund in Its First-Ever Impact Fundraise
filings.summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 25, 2026, titled "Capri Global Raises USD 30 Million from the BlueOrchard Microfinance Fund in Its First-Ever Impact Fundraise".
filings.ns: Capri Global Capital Limited raised USD 30 million from the BlueOrchard Microfinance Fund. This is the company's first-ever impact fundraise. The funds will support the MSME lending business. The transaction involves a private placement of senior secured USD-denominated bonds. The bonds have a tenor of 36 months. They mature in November 2029. BlueOrchard Finance Ltd is the sole investor. The bonds will be listed on NSE IFSC Limited. The issuance was completed through bilateral discussions. It is a standalone private placement outside the existing Global Medium-Term Note programme. The company has no plans to access the conventional GMTN dollar bond market in this financial year.

The agreement involves an investment of Rs. 2000 Cr over 4 years and the creation of 1000 jobs. The Government of Tamil Nadu will provide infrastructural support and regulatory facilitation. filings.name: Suzlon Energy Limited
filings.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
filings.subject: : Tamil Nadu Hon’ble CM lays foundation for Suzlon’s 1 GW smart blade factory in Thoothukudi.
filings.summary: Suzlon Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
filings.ns: Suzlon Energy Limited informs the exchange that the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister laid the foundation stone for its new one gigawatt smart blade manufacturing plant in Thoothukudi on 25th November 2026. This facility is Suzlon’s third plant in the state, complementing existing operations in Coimbatore. The proposed capacity is approximately 1,000 MW, with an investment of approximately Rs. 200 Crores funded through internal accruals. Construction is expected to be completed within approximately 12 months. The plant will manufacture blades up to 95 metres long for the S175 five megawatt turbine. It is projected to create over 1,000 jobs, with 80% of employment reserved for rural communities. The facility will be one of three AI-powered smart blade factories and will be 100% powered by renewable energy.

filings.name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited
filings.label: Monthly / business update (sales, volumes)
filings.subject: Navratri and Diwali Sales update for FY-27.
filings.summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited has informed the Exchange about Navratri and Diwali sales update for FY27.
filings.ns: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited reported festive sales of Rs. 1,419.67 million for the 45-day period from Ghatasthapana to Tripuri Purnima in FY27. This represents a year-on-year growth of 54.44 percent compared to Rs. 919.27 million in FY26. Revenue from operations excluding gold sales was Rs. 1,419.67 million. Gold sales were nil in FY27, compared to Rs. 34.72 million in FY26. Single-day revenue on Dhanteras reached Rs. 141.08 million, up 61.12 percent from Rs. 87.56 million in the previous year. The company now operates 41 stores, comprising seven EBO or COCO stores and 34 SIS stores. Consumer sentiment remains encouraging with resilient festive demand. The company expects the upcoming wedding season to further support demand.

filings.label: Substantial holding change (SAST / insider)
filings.subject: Disclosure under Regulation 18(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, as amended (the “SEBI (SAST) Regulations”)
filings.summary: Tata Steel Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 18 (6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
filings.ns: Tata Steel Limited acquired 2,77,38,075 equity shares of APL Apollo Tubes Limited from S Gupta Holding Private Limited on November 23, 2026, through an on-market block deal on BSE Limited. The purchase price was INR 2,100 per share. This acquisition represents approximately 9.99% of the total equity shares of APL Apollo Tubes Limited. Tata Steel Limited had previously disclosed its intent as an acquirer in a public announcement issued on November 23, 2026. A detailed public statement is to be published no later than December 1, 2026. The acquired shares are placed in a share escrow account in terms of Regulation 22(2A) of the SEBI SAST Regulations. filings.name: Bikaji Foods International Limited
filings.label: New product / launch
filings.subject: Disclosure
filings.summary: Bikaji Foods International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 25, 2026, titled "Bikaji Foods International Enters the Premium Bakery Segment with the Launch of Mahè under Bikaji Bakes".
filings.ns: Bikaji Foods International Limited announced the launch of Mahè, a premium bakery brand under its subsidiary Bikaji Bakes Private Limited. The venture is in partnership with Master Baker T K Khaleel. The launch introduces European-inspired viennoiseries, artisan breads, and cakes to the Indian market. The brand will be unveiled at Bakery Biz Mumbai from 25 to 27 November 2026. Production is supported by a manufacturing facility in Karnataka. This move marks the company's entry into the commercial bakery and foodservice segment. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The press release was issued on 25 November 2026.

The filing serves as a record for the exchanges and is available on the company website.

filings.ns: Angel One Limited disclosed a change in senior management personnel pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. Mr. Arief Mohamad, serving as Chief Business Officer for Direct Business, tendered his resignation on November 25, 2026. His last working day with the company will be December 31, 2026. The resignation letter and detailed reasons are enclosed as Annexure B. Additional details required under SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, are provided in Annexure A. The event occurred on November 25, 2026, at 07:50 a.m. IST. Naheed Patel, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, submitted this disclosure to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited for their information and records.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank jumps 18% as Bank Nifty hits a record. Has it recovered its 2026 losses?
headlines.summary: HDFC Bank shares have climbed 18.0% so far in November, on course for the stock's biggest monthly gain since November 2020, and the rally helped lift Bank Nifty to a record. Yet the stock is still 17.5% below its last close of 2025. The bank's consolidated profit rose YoY in every quarter it reported this year. What fell was the multiple of that profit investors were willing to pay.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 25: HUL soars 6%, Tata Consumer Products, HDFC Life surge 5%, Tata Steel falls 2%
headlines.summary: On November 25, the SENSEX advanced by 1.82% or 1,502.29 points to close at 83,938.28, while the NIFTY50 ended higher by 469.60 points or 1.85% at 25,819.25.

headlines.headline: SENSEX rallies over 1,300 pts, NIFTY50 above 25,650: Jupiter Wagons, L&T, Brigade Enterprises among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: Brigade Enterprises stock jumped as much as 6.8% to hit an intraday high of ₹621 per equity share on the NSE on Wednesday, as it acquired a 2.25-acre land parcel in Secunderabad, Hyderabad, through an outright purchase at ₹180 crore, with the sale deed registration now completed.

headlines.headline: Mid-market update: Indian equities defend opening gains; NIFTY50 trades above 25,700, SENSEX jumps 1700 pts
headlines.summary: The rally was largely confined to benchmark indices only, as midcap and smallcap indices traded in the red. NIFTY Midcap 100 traded in a flat-to-negative range, and the NIFTY Smallcap 100 index fell 0.62% on Wednesday afternoon.

headlines.headline: Infosys, Mphasis, TCS: IT stocks rally over 4% intraday, NIFTY IT gains 2.6%; what’s powering today’s momentum?
headlines.summary: Indian IT stocks rallied more than 4% during the trading session on Wednesday, November 25, with the NIFTY IT gaining 2.6% intraday as investors focused on the buying sentiment and the anti-AI trade amid a global market selloff.

headlines.headline: L&T shares jump over 2% on securing BESS order worth ₹1,000-2,500 crore in Gujarat; key details
headlines.summary: The project will feature a three-hour BESS, with a power capacity of 300 MW and an energy storage capacity of 900 MWh, L&T said.

headlines.headline: NIFTY Bank soars over 2% as ICICI Bank shares hit 52-week high; HDFC Bank, Axis Bank lead gains
headlines.summary: The NIFTY Bank index was supported by buying in the shares of ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, Axis Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank, which were among the top winners.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50 tops 25,700 in early trade, SENSEX up 1,400 pts; financials, Infosys among top gainers
headlines.summary: Global cues remain mixed, with investors rotating away from some US technology stocks towards other sectors. This could favour Indian domestic cyclicals and financials if buying broadens beyond a handful of index heavyweights.

headlines.headline: Profit booking: NIFTY50 drops 450 points, SENSEX falls 1.77%; Metals, and Banks among top laggards
headlines.summary: Weakness in global equities and the dollar index resulted in sharp selling pressure in metal stocks, which were the key laggards in today’s trading session. Tata Steel (-8.5%), Axis Bank (-3.9%), HDFC Bank (-3.3%), ICICI Bank (-3.3%), and Hindalco (-3.1%) were the top losers in Monday’s trading session.

headlines.headline: No 9:15 AM opening bell today: What's keeping Dalal Street shut on Tuesday, November 24?
headlines.summary: Trading across the equity and equity derivatives segments will remain suspended for the entire day. This means benchmark indices Sensex and NIFTY50 will not see any trading activity.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 23: Tata Steel tumbles over 8%, Axis Bank falls 4%, TCS jumps 3%; check list
headlines.summary: On November 23, the SENSEX declined by 1,483.72 points or 1.77% to close at 82,435.99, while the NIFTY50 fell by 450.95 points or 1.75% to end at 25,349.65.

headlines.headline: Axis Bank to Apollo Hospitals: 6 NIFTY100 stocks hit 52-week high despite stock market fall
headlines.summary: The real estate major DLF jumped 1.3% to hit 52-week high on Monday. It had reported a 10% jump in consolidated net profit of ₹1,301 crore for Q2 FY27.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX erase early gains to trade lower after strong opening; TCS, Shriram Finance, among top gainers
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices erased their early market gains on Monday, November 23, as investors booking profits while focusing on FII investment sustainability and global market selloff amid steady oil prices and US Treasury yields.

headlines.headline: Reliance Retail to Adani Airports: These are 14 of India's most valuable unlisted companies
headlines.summary: NSE and Jio Platforms were considered to be the most valuable companies in the unlisted space before they made their market debut. The spotlight now shifts to other big companies that have high valuation in the unlisted space. From Reliance Retail to Parle Products, here are the 13 companies whose IPOs investors are looking forward to.

headlines.headline: ICICI Bank to Meesho: Top 5 stocks hit record highs on November 20; how much have they gained?
headlines.summary: Several stocks, including big names like ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, among others have rallied to hit a fresh record high on Friday, November 20, with investors focusing on the sustained FII buying support and the trend reversal powering the intraday gains.
